ownership.quote: TensorPool Founded: 2025 Batch: Winter 2025 Team Size: 3 Status: Acquired Location: San Francisco

stage.note: TensorPool went through YC W25 (which itself is a pre-seed/seed investment of ~$500k), then the YC directory marks the company 'Acquired' with no acquirer named. No press release, Crunchbase/TechCrunch article, or company statement disclosing a priced seed/Series A round, an acquirer, or an acquisition price could be found in the time available; 'seed' reflects the YC investment as the only confirmed capital event, not a confirmed post-YC priced round.

note: YC directory confirms the same domain (tensorpool.dev) and lists TensorPool (W25, San Francisco; founders Tycho Svoboda CEO, Joshua Martinez CTO, Hlumelo Notshe CPO) with Status: Acquired, but does not name the acquirer or any deal terms. Independently, the provider card's own audit (2026-09-29) found engine.tensorpool.dev returning 503 'TensorPool is no longer accepting API requests', docs.tensorpool.dev no longer resolving, last blog post 2026-03-31, last CLI commit 2026-04-13, and last PyPI release 0.0.9 (2026-03-29) — consistent with the product being wound down/discontinued post-acquisition even though the marketing/pricing pages are still reachable. No acquirer, acquisition price, total funding, last round, or revenue figures were locatable within the ~15-minute research budget.
